body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2026-04-28 (Q4FY26 concall transcript): "For FY '27, we are giving a guidance of 15% growth on revenue and approximately a 30% growth in bottom line." Metric: Consolidated revenue / PAT growth FY27. Target: revenue ~INR 6,386 cr (+15%); PAT ~INR 270 cr (+30% on 207 cr). Deadline: 2027-03-31. Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: pending. Evidence: H1FY27 revenue INR 2,694 cr, +7%. Needs ~+21-22% in H2. Management now says 'at worst 13-14%'. H1 PAT INR 114 cr, +40% (helped by lower finance cost after the equity raise).

data.conditionality: framed as 'conservative' because of export/Middle East and freight; 'effort will be to go higher'
